t: What is Happening with iPhone Camera?

q.x: There was a very good video from Marques Brownlee about the issue [1]. IPhone cameras are getting worse. [1] [link]

recs.x:
On my S21 Ultra the viewfinder will sometimes show a brightened image, to what I would prefer.

A long hold on the focus point brings up an exposure slider, which lets you easily darken the image. It works really well, but the Samsung doesn't quite have the "flatten everything" feature that Marques talked about though ( [link] - recommend watching this).

There was a very good video from Marques Brownlee about the issue [1]. IPhone cameras are getting worse.

[1] [link]

cites.x: Having watched the MKBHD video in question ( [link] ), I believe he's actually saying that iPhones light people's faces up uniformly, even when light is coming distinctly from one side.
